review.summary: Phase 26's plan, provenance tooling and governance are strong and the eight-command receipt is genuinely executed against the reviewed source 95f6cc2 (docs/reviews/phase-26-attempt-02.checks.json, all exit 0, 9/51/26 tests run). Every attempt-01 phase finding and every residual from the accepted 44/50 chunk review is closed with executed code, not prose: the baseline 0.34.0 ledger is now hash- and commit-bound (verify_typescript035_source.py:13-21) with a tamper test, the locked Zod range is checked (:24-27), the SDK freeze now compares the full path set (test_typescript035_governance.py:137-141), and the response-validation divergence is slated for CHANGELOG/STABILITY (plan:206-210). Shortfall is small but real: the only declared chunk's accepted record is still bound to the superseded source, the new committed-hygiene command is vacuous at HEAD==578f2e6 while the new artifacts are untracked, and two cosmetic/citation defects remain. 45/50 — just below the phase threshold.

findings.description: Acceptance criterion 2 is not yet satisfied for the reviewed source. The only declared chunk's latest terminal record is attempt 2, accepted at 44/50 but bound to source fbb0173… (:6), which the corrections superseded; chunk attempt 3 has only a prompt and a checks snapshot at 95f6cc2 (docs/reviews/phase-26-chunk-plan-and-provenance-attempt-03.checks.json:3) and no record. tools/review_phase.py:355-365 selects the highest-numbered chunk record and permits a stale accepted chunk only when record['attempt'] == 5 with an accepted current complete-phase review, so accepted_chunks() would raise 'Latest chunk review is rejected, stale, or invalid: plan-and-provenance' today. The gate is correctly fail-closed and docs/phase-status.json:6824 discloses the concurrency, but no accepted chunk evidence covers the current source, and this phase review cannot substitute for it.
findings.required_fix: Obtain the terminal accepted chunk record docs/reviews/phase-26-chunk-plan-and-provenance-attempt-03.json on source 95f6cc2 before tools/review_phase.py --advance; do not relax the attempt-5 restriction at tools/review_phase.py:362 or rewrite the preserved attempt-02 record.

findings.description: The newly added committed-hygiene command is vacuous in the reviewed state and the chunk-review coverage gap it was meant to close is still open. HEAD equals the baseline (docs/checks/phase-26-private-material.json:5 headCommit 578f2e63…), so ['git','diff','--check','578f2e6..HEAD'] diffs nothing (0.002s, docs/reviews/phase-26-attempt-02.checks.json:38-42), while every new artifact — docs/typescript-035-parity-plan.md, tools/verify_typescript035_source.py, tools/test_typescript035_governance.py, contracts/sources/typescript-0.35.0/** — is untracked and therefore outside all three hygiene commands. docs/typescript-035-parity-plan.md:215-216 ('Hygiene covers tracked working/index changes and baseline-to-HEAD history') reads broader than the executed coverage. I independently grepped the plan, both new tools and the pinned source and found no trailing-whitespace, leading-tab or space-before-tab defect, so this is coverage and claim accuracy, not a live defect. Note also that once committed, this command will scan the pinned upstream bytes without the vendor exclusion used for phases 21-25 (tools/test_management_phases.py:122-126).
findings.required_fix: Add an untracked-artifact hygiene check to commands_for(26) (e.g. git diff --check --no-index over `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard`, excluding contracts/sources/typescript-0.35.0 immutable bytes) and assert it in tools/test_typescript035_governance.py, or narrow the claim at docs/typescript-035-parity-plan.md:215-216 to tracked modifications plus committed history.

findings.description: One missing inter-word space remains from the chunk review's last low finding: 'chunks >=42 (target45)'. The other reported instances are fixed (plan:161-162, :169, :199; docs/PHASES.md:278,280; docs/phase-status.json:6819 now read correctly).

The plan cites 'the actual existing generic projection serializer (generate_models.py:485–511)'. The serializer is at tools/generate_models.py:497-506 (KNOWN excludes projection wires at :498; the extension loop skips a projection key only when the typed field is set at :503-505); :485-496 is the custom Deserialize and :507-511 is builder/SCHEMA emission. The substantive claim is correct — I re-verified it — but the load-bearing citation points at the wrong range.
findings.required_fix: Correct the citation at docs/typescript-035-parity-plan.md:116 to tools/generate_models.py:497-506 (and reference :485-496 separately for the projection-preserving Deserialize).

findings.description: The interruption fix covers only KeyboardInterrupt. A SIGTERM or SIGKILL between prompt creation (:576) and record writing still leaves a prompt/checks pair with neither a review record nor a .failed.json, which re-creates the dead-end class behind the attempt-01 high finding: :501-502 forbids reusing the attempt and verify_attempt_sequence (:107-108) fails the next one. The only recovery is a hand-authored failure receipt, and nothing attributes that receipt to the tool, so docs/typescript-035-parity-plan.md:203-204 ('Future interrupted Claude invocations retain a sanitized failure receipt') is broader than the implementation.
findings.required_fix: Install a SIGTERM handler (or wrap the subprocess call in try/except BaseException) that calls failed_invocation('interrupted') before re-raising, and either regression-test it or narrow the plan claim at docs/typescript-035-parity-plan.md:203-204 to interactive interruption.

Prior low findings closed: the SDK freeze now compares full path sets (tools/test_typescript035_governance.py:137-141 asserts set(git ls-files --cached --others -- crates/scm-sdk) == set(git ls-tree -r 578f2e6 -- crates/scm-sdk) plus an empty untracked set), the locked oracle dependency is bound (verify_zod_versions at :24-27 requires package['dependencies']['zod'] == '^3.24.0' and 3.24.0 <= tools/package-lock.json zod < 4.0.0, with 3.23.0/4.0.0 negative cases at test_typescript035_governance.py:35-38), and the response-side divergence is now an explicit publication requirement (docs/typescript-035-parity-plan.md:206-210).

I counted 699 'path' entries in contracts/sources/typescript-0.35.0/git-tree.json, matching plan:184.

limitations: Read-only Read/Glob/Grep with no shell: I could not recompute any SHA-256, SHA-1, git blob or git tree hash. The reviewed fingerprint 95f6cc26…, the checks digest c2172eb4…, MANIFEST_SHA256 89831a8c… and all per-file digests were assessed for internal consistency and for what the code does with them, not recomputed; my delta corroboration rests on the two committed ledgers' recorded blob ids and byte counts.

The eight phase-26 commands were not re-executed; I assessed the recorded receipt (docs/reviews/phase-26-attempt-02.checks.json, docs/checks/phase-26.json) and the code those commands run. That this prompt exists is indirect evidence that validate_predecessors and verify_attempt_sequence accepted attempt-01's preserved record, prompt and CLI output.

I cannot verify that chunk attempt 3 is a live in-flight invocation rather than an abandoned one; I only observed its prompt and a checks snapshot bound to 95f6cc2 with no terminal record, and recorded the consequence for accepted_chunks().

Upstream commit 780c985cac90144ea1884fe6cffa58b5deec9ac4 cannot be authenticated offline and no .local/typescript checkout exists (nor is one required). The pin proves internal Git-object consistency (commit object -> 699-file tree -> each pinned blob) at parity with the enforced 0.34.0 standard, not that this is the published upstream release.

No executed check byte-freezes docs/PHASES.md or docs/implementation-plan.md against 578f2e6; both appear additive (new sections at PHASES.md:268-282, implementation-plan.md:186-191, with the historical rubric and budget rules intact), and tools/test_management_phases.py asserts key no-reset phrases, but I could not diff them without a shell.

Phase 27/28 obligations were not assessed and are not deliverables here: the additive overlay, contracts/typescript-035-parity.json and its owner, the oracle corpus, the claimed 12-node ancestor closure, the full phase-27 command set and the 0.2.4 readiness/delivery guard are declared later work. No Rust, generator or oracle execution exists yet by design, so the schema-root, projection and validation design was judged only as a plan against current source and the pinned TypeScript.

I read no credential or tenant-registration file and nothing outside this repository, and did not open contracts/sources/typescript-0.35.0/test/models/fixtures/directional-security-profile.json; its identifier inventory was assessed from tools/verify_typescript035_source.py:87-89, manifest.json:65 and the private-material receipt.
